reviews.review:
DO NOT BUY THIS GAME!
This is probably one of the worst ports I've played so far on the PC. This game was pretty clearly developed for console. With little video settings to change, there isn't much wiggle room for people who want to tweak their performance issues, which you will probably have.
Even if you do get the game to run at a reasonable framerate, there's the multiplayer issues. For the most part the gameplay is fun, but is totally ruined by the fact that the player base is SO small, and there are no dedicated servers. This is done much like how Gears of War 1 P2P servers worked, as in it didn't. These local hosts usually either live in the UK, or in Africa. Pings usually are yellow or red, and there is a "dynamic" host changer to "optimize" everyones pings, but this ends up in the game locking itself every 5 minute for about 3 minutes saying "Changing Host".
I only bought this game because I'm a huge fan of the 40K lore, don't buy this game.

Single player campaign is great.  Not the deepest story ever but in 40k we're not asking for much.  Satisfying but a bit short.

Multiplayer is nothing special.

Never a fan of the Warhammer 40K series but this is an excellent game. I got it for cheap and it was worth every penny.

Great story, great gameplay, and nice graphics. Really good deviation from my typical BF3 and MW3 nights.

Anyone who is a fan of the series should definitely buy this game. And anyone who isn't a fan buy it and play it. Really good game and something different for everyone to try out.

Also Relic was the developer of this game, the developers of Company of Heroes. So take a look into it. It is like the best rated RTS. F*** anything from Blizzard.
i am not recomending this. The marines do feel a little third-riech....fun for the first hour...less fun each progressing inute after.
